changelog:
Orion 3.11 — the Terminal, fixed end to end.

THE TERMINAL ALWAYS OPENS. The fix that ended the old dead-end is verified in place: the Terminal opens every time, builds its own phone tools when the voice engine is down, and says so in plain words when even that fails. This build then fixed four more faults the end-to-end audit found behind it.

NO MORE LYING ABOUT WHERE YOU ARE. Going up a folder at the very top used to move the Terminal's shown place to a folder that does not exist, while your commands actually ran at the top. Fixed — the place the Terminal shows is the place your commands run.

PLAIN WORDS ONLY. A few failure messages could still show raw technical text — long file paths and system error codes. Every one of those spots now says what happened in plain words instead.

NO MORE WEDGED TERMINAL. A phone command that stalled — a system service that never answers, a yes-or-no tap that never comes — used to freeze the Terminal for the whole session: the run button dead, every later command refused, nothing said. Phone commands now stop at two minutes, say so in plain words, and hand control back.

FAST FOLDER CHANGES LAND RIGHT. Two quick folder changes could finish out of order and leave the Terminal in the older one. Only the newest change counts now.

And the first-open self-check is armored: no surprise during startup can take the app down — worst case it prints one plain line and the Terminal still opens.
